method: Complete pinned changelog read, Git/SHA256 verification and cross-check against previously reviewed source/tests. Historical fix entries are leads, not executed regression proof.
findings: Unreleased2.11.0-rc.0 confirms GTK3.22/Python3.12/GLib2.74 and hard json-glib dependency, supporting earlier findings that some older GUI/install prose is stale.

XOR cancellation protection is explicitly listed; previously executed treemerge equality control still accepts A^3B versus AB^3 multiplicity pattern. Added protection is not a complete multiset equality proof.

Regression leads include FIFO nonstripped deadlock, size overflow,32-bit large-file hashing, quote/invalidUTF8 output, replay missing checksums, empty stdin directory merging and symlink/regular-file confusion. Existing tests must be assessed per case, not inferred from fix label.

Cache entries mention locale-sensitive mtime, intermediate checksum storage and disabling xattr writes for clamp mode. These do not establish robustness against same-size content rewrites preserving mtime, which requires separate controls.
Path beyond PATH_MAX now intended hard error rather than truncation; any skip/partial/error policy comparison must distinguish this from complete path support.
Historical coverage claim90percent lines/almostall functions explicitly excludes branch coverage and supplies no current report. Cannot prove all-cases goal.
Repeated reflink fixes and inline-extent exit12 show filesystem-specific result states; exact content grouping and physical extent dedupe need separate qualification.

Feature history changes defaults and options over time: SHA1 toBLAKE2b, -U meaning, installation prefix, schema/appID and GUI controls. Older screenshots/benchmarks/docs cannot qualify current defaults.
Root-level xattr metadata cache/SQLite strategy was added then removed historically. Do not recommend obsolete switches as current memory controls.
Fatal-signal/interruption exit-status fixes do not repair separately observed GUI finish-state loss or unchecked archive return. Caller propagation remains distinct.
limits: No historical binaries, linked issues, current coverage instrumentation or upstream suite executed.
